goal: Reuse Playwright managed Chromium as the default server browser worker without introducing a new browser engine.

SERVER_MANAGED_BROWSER.launch_policy: one isolated browser context per job unless a reusable approved session policy explicitly applies
SERVER_MANAGED_BROWSER.profile_policy: ephemeral by default; durable login/profile reuse requires separate authority
SERVER_MANAGED_BROWSER.network_policy: respect target site and project authorization; no bypass or stealth expansion

REMOTE_AGENT_SESSION.engine: Existing local Chrome/Chromium through authenticated Browser Agent
REMOTE_AGENT_SESSION.connection_path: Existing Server -> Existing Secure Tunnel -> Browser Agent 127.0.0.1:32100 -> localhost CDP 127.0.0.1:9222
REMOTE_AGENT_SESSION.activation_gate: existing tunnel exact route/config readback and server binding ready

job_worker_loop: claim QUEUED or resumable JOB with lease
load RECIPE, ADAPTER, SESSION_REGISTRY and RESUME_STATE
choose SERVER_MANAGED_BROWSER unless job explicitly binds REMOTE_AGENT_SESSION
append redacted TRACE event per material step
checkpoint RESUME_STATE after each successful step
on transient failure persist retry_wait and resume cursor
on terminal success/failure release lease and persist final receipt

failure_recovery.worker_process_restart: new worker loads persisted JOB+RESUME_STATE and resumes unfinished step
failure_recovery.server_restart: server reconstructs runnable queue from durable JOB states RUNNING/RETRY_WAIT/PAUSED using lease expiry rules
failure_recovery.duplicate_result: deduplicate by job_id + idempotency_key + dataset record identity

capacity_prebuild.scaling: not authorized in this prebuild; successor may tune only under existing server resource policy
capacity_prebuild.long_running_jobs: supported by durable server ownership rather than chat/panel lifetime
